properties.inspection_comments: Purpose: To conduct a food safety inspection in accordance with WAC Chapter 246-215. Due to 35 or more red points, a follow-up inspection will be conducted for the red item violations noted in this inspection report. A fee of $230 will be assessed by mail for all follow-up inspections. If repeated red item violations are observed at a follow-up inspection, an additional follow-up inspection will be required. Notes: - Be sure to wash, rinse, sanitize, and air dry all dishes in the 3 compartment sink. - Facility is using time as a control for tzatziki sauce. Inspector will work with manager to develop procedures. Written procedure must be maintained on site. - Ensure all food is wholesome and free from spoilage. ------------------------------------------- Violation #21 continued: During this inspection the following red high risk violation(s) has been cited for a fifth time in your last five inspections. Red Item #21 - Improper cold holding: 1. Cited 1/27/2025 - Discussed with Person In Charge (PIC). 2. Cited 2/4/2025 - Discussed with PIC. 3. Cited 2/12/2025 - Created a risk control plan with PIC. 4. Cited 7/1/2025 - An educational visit is required. 5. Cited 12/ 11/2025 - Closed for 24 hours. An informal conference is required. Next steps are as follows: • Charged pre-opening inspection ($230). • Informal administrative conference. • Create a risk control plan with the inspector. • Charged follow-up inspection ($230). If there is a 6th inspection with repeated red item violation(s): • Facility is closed for 24 hours. • Charged pre-opening inspection ($230). • Formal administrative conference ($828). • Probation for 6 months: -Five additional inspections ($460 each). -Facility is closed if a probation violation cited. This facility must close per Tacoma -Pierce County Health Department enforcement policy. At the time of the inspection you were cited for the same violation for a fifth time in the last five inspections. Stop all food and beverage preparation immediately. Failure to stop operating is a violation of WAC Chapter 246-215-08600 (2). If the facility is found operating without approval, the facility will be assessed $1,143 the first time and $2,070 for each additional incident. A pre -opening inspection is required before reopening. You will be billed $230 for the pre-opening inspection. An informal administrative conference is now required. The conference will be held at Tacoma -Pierce County Health Department located at 3629 South D Street in Tacoma , WA. Contact your inspector listed at the bottom of this report within 1 week to schedule. The owner and manager are required to attend. Translation services will be provided by third party if necessary . Compliance Schedule OBSERVATIONS AND CORRECTIVE ACTIONS You must complete the following items by the due date listed below . Your inspector will do a compliance inspection . If these items are not corrected, you will be billed for the inspection. Violations cited must be corrected within the time frames specified . Complete ByItem Number 12/18/2025 4000 Food and non-food surfaces properly used and constructed; cleanable. 4000 Observed the following: - Cardboard used to line shelves and manufacturer plastic left on coolers throughout the facility. - Raw chicken stored in large plastic bin too large to fit in facility's 3 compartment sink. Tub does not appear to be food safe. Remove all cardboard and manufacturer from shelves and equipment. All surfaces must be smooth, easily cleanable and non-absorbent. All containers used for food storage must be made of food grade plastic. Do not use trash bags or un-approved plastic containers for food storage. Replace the bin with a food grade model that can be washed, rinsed, and sanitized in the 3 comp sink. *A compliance order has been created to replace the plastic bin with a food grade model that can be washed , rinsed, and sanitized in the 3 comp sink by 12/18/2025. Failure to do so will result in a non-compliance fee of $230. Contact your inspector with questions or if you need more time to complete these items.
